comment: winape_match.py --config: an EXAMPLE. The part names and first fields are made-up placeholders;
a port lists its original's own parts (from the reference: the field each part's picture first
appears, cpcboot.py's frames and contact.py). Every key is optional (winape_match.py DEFAULTS).
parts: [first field, name], ascending; a field belongs to the last part that starts at or before it.
capture_box [x0, y0, x1, y1] and capture_scale: where the picture is in a winape_shot.ps1 capture
(these values: WinAPE 2.0b2, -Size 820,720, __COMPAT_LAYER=HighDpiAware; check one capture by eye).
ref_dy, ref_dx: the same picture's place in a cpcboot.py fNNNNN.png (312 x 512).
height, width: the compared picture in scanlines and mode-1 pixels.
level_lo, capture_hi, ref_hi: a gun is level 0 / 1 / 2 above lo / hi (WinAPE 0/99/247, ours 0/128/255).
t0_ms: ms after launch of the reference's field 0 (the time WinAPE takes to start and reset); field_ms.
window: fields either side of the time's estimate to search; min_score: below it, no diff (a load, a fade).
overrides: [{file, first_field, row0, xrep, lines, cols}] raw hardware-colour fields replacing the
reference from first_field on (file relative to this config).
